mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, 0 AS is_assistant FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT creator_id FROM know_posts WHERE id = #{postId} AND status != 'deleted' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET reply_count = reply_count + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'published'
UPDATE comments SET reply_count = IF(reply_count > 0, reply_count - 1, 0), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comments SET status = 'deleted', content = '', update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'published'
